context: Ren consults Asuka about referencing a source.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic guidance; vocabulary (著作/参照/疑問/賞/与える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この著作を、参照してもいいですか?
lines.style: earnest young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、参照する時は出典を示しましょう。
lines.en: Yes, show the source when you reference it.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 内容に、疑問が残るんです。
lines.en: I still have a question about the content.
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その疑問を、論文で扱うといいですよ。
lines.en: It's good to address that question in your paper.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この著作は、賞を取ったんですか?
lines.en: Did this work win an award?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、大きな賞を与えられました。
lines.en: Yes, it was given a major award.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 私にも、ヒントを与えてくれそうです。
lines.en: It seems it'll give me hints too.
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 疑問を、参照で深めていきましょう。
lines.en: Let's deepen your question through references.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
